title: Multiplying and Dividing Integers
summary: Sign rules from patterns: why negative × negative is positive, and how to divide integers.

ib.note: Sign rules are MYP 2 Number; the pattern argument builds Criterion B

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 2: Operations with Integers

objectives: I can multiply and divide integers using the sign rules.
I can explain the sign rules using patterns.
I can use integer multiplication in real-life problems.
misconceptions: The sign rules are just rules to memorise, with no reason.
Division of integers follows different sign rules from multiplication.
